system.description:
Grappling Hook (Boost): Prerequisite: Nimble Hands. Provided you have a Grappling Hook equipped in your RIS, you may use the Affix Rope action to affix rope to any point within Xft, where X is the length of your rope, instead of to a spot within 5ft.

1 Item Slot (RIS Passive) · 20gc · Climbing Tools, rulebook p.203
